scope: Normal owned Tk Run/Takeoff/seven direction buttons/altitude/release/Stop/publisher loss/Land. Native X500/PX4 and independent Gazebo body; one open static map, no obstacle planner.
command: ros2 launch robot_lab_bringup simulated_robot.launch.py robot_model:=px4_x500 simulator:=gazebo use_sim_time:=false map_name:=terrain_stairs world_package:=robot_lab_maps world_name:=terrain_stairs world_path:=maps/terrain_stairs/worlds/terrain_stairs.world map_yaml:=maps/terrain_stairs/maps/map.yaml mode:=flight gui:=false aerial_obstacles:=none

takeoff_check.error: Selected world blocks the minimum 0.8 m takeoff corridor; choose a different spawn.

error: AssertionError(('Takeoff check', {'state': 'failed', 'error': 'Selected world blocks the minimum 0.8 m takeoff corridor; choose a different spawn.'}))
